name: 大唐双龙传（LLMUD）
english_name: Twin Dragons of the Tang Dynasty (LLMUD)
english_description: LLMUD v0.11, adapted from Huang Yi's novel "Twin Dragons of the Tang Dynasty" and a sister build sharing the same underlying architecture as dtsl. Set at the fall of the Sui dynasty and the rise of Tang, players start at the Great Tang Academy and grow through four core attributes assigned at registration, joining sects and factions amid a jianghu of rival warlords; wizards and admins carry the in-game title "Heavenly Emperor."
